attributes.board_name: Indiana Board of Pharmacy (Professional Licensing Agency)

rules.notes: License renews without a CE requirement. The Board's renewal information lists only the expiry (June 30 of even-numbered years) and the $25 fee for technicians, while pharmacists must complete 30 hours of CE before renewal; the technician renewal form asks no CE question.
rules.rule_quote: Pharmacy Technician Licenses expire June 30 of even-numbered years and the renewal fee is $25.00.
